_help: Staff-only Discord channels the assistant reads for the latest announcements. Add each channel's ID (right-click the channel > Copy Channel ID) and a short name. Pinned posts are always included; other posts from the last 'days' days are included, newest first, up to 'maxChars' characters in total.
_logChannelHelp: Private staff channel where the bot records strikes, blocks and unblocks (and reads them back). Never list it under 'channels'.
